raw_segments.text: Friar Lawrence, hold, daughter, I do spy a kind of hope, which craves as desperate an
execution as that is desperate which we would prevent.
If rather than to marry County Paris thou hast the strength of will to slay thyself,
then is it likely thou wilt undertake a thing like death to chide away this shame, that
copstee with death himself to escape from it?
And if thou dost, I'll give thee remedy.
